summary: Cultus Mountain lookout, Deschutes County, OR: 1925 or 1935 first tower, replaced 1958; abandoned 1963 per register, sold and burned 1968 per two others. Site today not described.

facts.design: 20-foot round tower with a 10x10 L-5 cab (1935); 1958 replacement a 20-foot treated timber tower with an R-6 cab
facts.status_note: Register and FireLookout.com say abandoned 1963 and gone; Forest Lookouts and the Deschutes County Fire Lookouts blog give removal in 1968. No source describes remains.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and FireLookout.com date a 9x9 tower to 1925; Forest Lookouts and the Deschutes County Fire Lookouts blog begin in 1933-1935 and list no 1925 tower. Story gives the 1925 claim and the later record. Not reconciled.

Register and FireLookout.com say abandoned 1963. Forest Lookouts and the Deschutes County Fire Lookouts blog say removed in 1968, and Forest Lookouts says sold as surplus, stripped and burned. Story reports both dates. Not reconciled.

notes_for_editor: Read: the Former Fire Lookout Sites Register page, FireLookout.com, Forest Lookouts' Cultus page (dated Oregon and Bend newspaper items 1933-1968) and the Deschutes County Fire Lookouts blog. The dates conflict as noted in resolved_conflicts. No staffing or fire record was found, so none is in the story. The State Library of Oregon record for the 1991 Deschutes National Forest eligibility report (digitalcollections.library.oregon.gov/nodes/view/275303) was read as a catalogue entry only, not the report itself; the report may describe Cultus Mountain and could settle the dates. No source describes the site or access today.
